legend.0: none: No reliably observed physical defect in the target region.
legend.1: cosmetic: Superficial deterioration only, e.g. small isolated rust or paint damage without discernible metal deformation.
legend.2: minor: Visible local metal dent, crease or deformation of limited extent with no evident rupture.
legend.3: moderate: Clearly substantial deformation affecting a large part of the visible leaf region.
legend.4: major: Very extensive severe distortion or obvious door-panel rupture/perforation; visual assessment only, NOT repair acceptance criteria.
